name: SKAN crowd anonymity tiers
plain: Apple withholds detail from postbacks when too few installs came from a campaign.
meaning: Protects individuals in small groups: low install counts get less detail. Small advertisers lose signal first.

ios.note: Four tiers (0 to 3). Higher tiers unlock 3 or 4 digit source identifiers and fine conversion values; tier 0 gives the least data. Thresholds are secret and Apple does not publish them.

fields.name: conversion value
fields.range: none, coarse, or fine by tier

limits.headline: Can't get much detail when too few people installed from an ad
limits.user_action: Nothing. Apple applies the rules by itself
can: Send full detail for large campaigns
Send a 3 or 4 digit campaign ID in higher tiers
Send a detailed score in higher tiers
cannot: See the exact limits; Apple keeps them secret
Get detail for small campaigns at tier 0
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 16.1 and later). Not used on Android.

story.what_it_is: Apple hides detail from ad reports when too few people came from a campaign.

marketing.name: SKAdNetwork crowd anonymity
marketing.pitch: Reports include less detail when a campaign has few installs, to protect people in small groups.

story.for_you: You never see it. If you are one of few people who installed from a niche ad, Apple makes sure the report cannot point to you.
story.for_makers: The more installs a campaign has, the more detail the report shows. Small advertisers lose the most detail first, so many test big first or combine campaigns.

use_cases.example: A new indie studio runs a tiny test and gets only a basic count back.
A big ad network sees full values for large campaigns, but only a coarse one for small ones.
A boutique retailer merges its campaigns into one to reach a higher detail tier.
A measurement team models what small campaigns would look like at scale.
Small groups cannot be singled out, which protects rare users.
A developer reads postbacks and finds blank values due to low volume.

story.ios_note: Part of SKAdNetwork 4 on iOS 16.1 and later.

abuse: Advertisers split campaigns to game thresholds

history.change: Tiered data disclosure introduced in SKAN 4
